factual_claims.claim: AB KN Energies reported improved financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, driven by full LNG terminal operations, higher regasification volumes, and positive capacity pricing, despite elevated costs and regulatory adjustments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue, gross profit, operating profit, PBT and net profit all increased vs 2024; notes explain full commercial service after 2024 dry-dock, higher regasification volumes and capacity booking bonuses; cost of sales and operating expenses rose; security supplement income reduced due to 2022-2023 excess return repayment.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Revenue, gross profit, operating profit, profit before tax, and net profit figures are presented in a consistent sequence with matching growth percentages and prior-year comparatives. Explanations of revenue drivers and offsets (S6–S7) logically precede the cost-of-sales discussion (S8–S9), which in turn precedes operating-expense and financing commentary (S10–S11). Cash-flow and liquidity statements (S12–S13) follow naturally from the profitability narrative. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems are present, and repetition is minimal and non-disruptive.
